model.novaSenhaDiferente: The new password needs to be different from the current one.
model.informeUmEmailValido: Enter a valid email or an address starting with https://.

confirmTwoFactorDialog.osCodigosAntigosNao: The old codes no longer work.
confirmTwoFactorDialog.codigoDe6Digitos: 6-digit code from the app or a recovery code.
confirmTwoFactorDialog.suaContaVolta: Your account goes back to only asking for the password to log in. The current recovery codes stop working.
confirmTwoFactorDialog.osCodigosAtuaisDeixam: The current codes stop working and you get 10 new ones.
confirmTwoFactorDialog.informeUmCodigo: Enter a code from the app or a recovery code.

devicesSection.ondeASuaConta: Where your account is open. Ending a device ends its access right away. Changing the password ends all the others.

enableTwoFactorDialog.useUmAppAutenticador: Use an authenticator app to generate a code every time you log in.
enableTwoFactorDialog.qrCodeParaO: QR code for the authenticator app
enableTwoFactorDialog.naoConsegueEscanearDigite: Can't scan it? Type this secret into the app:
enableTwoFactorDialog.abraOAppAutenticador: Open the authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password or another) and scan the QR code.
enableTwoFactorDialog.digiteOCodigo: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.

recoveryCodesView.guardeEstesCodigosEm: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once, in case you lose access to the authenticator app. They won't appear again.
recoveryCodesView.naoFoiPossivelCopiar: Couldn't copy. Select and copy by hand.
recoveryCodesView.guardeiMeusCodigosEm: I saved my codes somewhere safe
